description: This file provides classes and helper functions for parsing and building WebSocket frames according to RFC 6455, including frame creation, parsing, fragmentation, and connection management.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket frame with header fields and payload.

classes.name: FragmentedFrameBuilder
classes.description: A stateful class to send a message as fragmented frames.

classes.name: StreamOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for WebSocket stream behavior.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Handles parsing and building WebSocket frames, manages connection state, fragmentation, and message processing.

methods.name: create_length_header
methods.description: Creates a length header for WebSocket frames based on payload size and masking.

methods.name: create_header
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket frame header with specified parameters.

methods.name: create_binary_frame
methods.description: Constructs a binary WebSocket frame from message data.

methods.name: create_text_frame
methods.description: Constructs a text WebSocket frame from message data.

methods.name: parse_frame
methods.description: Parses raw bytes into WebSocket frame components and payload.
